# Hypeauditor

HypeAuditor provides comprehensive influencer marketing solutions, offering tools for influencer discovery, analytics, and campaign management across multiple social media platforms.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hypeauditor/.

## Actions

- **Get Instagram Account Media** (read-only): Retrieve media content of an Instagram account.
- **Get Instagram report** (read-only): Retrieve a detailed Instagram report.
- **Get TikTok Analytics Report** (read-only): Get TikTok analytics report.
